The '''105th Stormtrooper Platoon''' was a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] that served in the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Stationed aboard [[Starlyte Station]], the platoon supported Imperial liaison officer [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Arissa Fawn]].

[[File:Brezzic_Marr.png|thumb|left|170px|Brezzic Marr, commanding officer of the 105th Stormtrooper Platoon]]

Nicknamed "The Emperor's Irregulars", the unit's [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] were regarded as none-too-bright and none-too-competent, and various remarks made about them suggested that they might have been psychologically damaged.

The impression of eccentricity was enhanced by the fact that their [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Brezzic Marr]], encouraged the personalization of their [[Armor/Legends|armor]], so that each Stormtrooper wore the 105th's platoon symbol, combining the cog of the Empire with a lightning bolt, on their right shoulder, and they also adopted individual badges. One had the [[Mandalorian crest|Mythosaur skull]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] on the brow of his helmet, another had a [[Jaster Mereel's sigil|sigil]] from [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]] on his body armor. Their somewhat bizarre appearance was further reinforced by Commander Marr's enthusiasm for parading his men around the station, setting their pace with rhythmic chants that onlookers often found amusing.

However, not withstanding their unconventonal qualities, their regular marching drill gave the platoon strict military discipline, and they also displayed the usual stormtrooper characteristics of fanatical loyalty and unyielding determination in combat.

Their standard weapon was the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[Freedom_Two|Stormtrooper-Two]], a wildly inaccurate but ludicrously overpowered copy of the standard [[E-11 blaster rifle/E-11|E-11]], and the typical trooper generally also carried a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] as well.
